name: B10-0232/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of five jailed journalists in Cameroon: Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad. It says Cameroon's authorities lock up reporters on charges like "false news" or anti-state activity, often before military courts, and some journalists have died in custody. The Parliament asks Cameroon to respect press freedom, asks European diplomats to watch trials and visit detained journalists, and asks the European Union to consider sanctions. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking, not deciding.
- **Who it affects:** Cameroon's government, jailed journalists, and European diplomats and governments.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to European Union officials and Cameroon's authorities; they decide whether to act.
